text:
miri: Heads-up — new user following the Node quickstart hit a 402 on their first API call. Console shows 'Set payment method' which conflicted with the quickstart wording about trial credits.

alex: Can you paste the exact curl/SDK snippet + workspace id so we can reproduce?

miri: workspace rdw-tryme-9. curl: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-1.0\",\"input\":\"hello\"}'
Response: {\"error\":{\"code\":402,\"message\":\"Workspace payment method required: workspace rdw-tryme-9\"}}

sam: That's expected after the recent policy change: production-tier models now require a payment method. We didn't update the quickstart text to call this out — my bad.

miri: What's the recommended workaround for folks who expect a frictionless first call?

sam: Recommend the preview model for onboarding: use "redwood-mini-preview" in the quickstart example. It's not gated and has a small free allowance for demos.

jess: I'll file a console UX ticket to add a tooltip on 'Set payment method' saying: "Production models require a payment method; use the preview model for trial calls." Also adding an FAQ entry so CS can explain the change.

alex: Devex checklist: 1) update quickstart to show a preview-model fallback, 2) add a short troubleshooting note for 402, 3) include a one-line SDK snippet showing how to override the model.

miri: Pushed a docs patch with the preview fallback and troubleshooting note. Testing now...

miri: Switched to redwood-mini-preview and got 200: {\"id\":\"resp_demo\",\"output\":[{\"content\":[{\"type\":\"output_text\",\"text\":\"hello!\"}]}]}

devex-bot: Runbook link added to the onboarding guide -> https://go/release/runbooks/onboarding-billing-blocks

sam: Thanks — let's also add an internal CS blurb summarizing the policy change so reps don't mislead customers.

jess: Filing follow-up for product-flag to allow a single un-gated sample call for verified org domains; cc @alex-pm.

miri: Closing thread; quickstart PR link in comments.
